note: C4 positive controls (55 C4): one catalogue fault per aspect, run as `npm run corpus -- --controls` (2.7 and every gate). Skeleton written at 2.5: every `fault` is null until the 2.7 fault catalogue exists and the control gave >= 1 diff on its aspect at 2.7. Fixing or changing a control is an acceptance change (40 §8 rule 8): owner SIGNED, full C1 + C1-Q re-run.

live.what: a release image of a catalogue fault with a status .expect, run beside the reference, must fail the live A/B (55 C4 --live)

rules: each control changes read-only corpus URLs only (never a fault seen only on a mutating call or a state change, e.g. R-028, R-033)
a control with 0 diffs on its aspect fails C4; the gate record lists them
